prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>: young East Asian woman, long dark hair in a low side ponytail, long beige-grey cardigan over a light top. Her face, eye shape, eyebrows and hairstyle follow <Picture 1> exactly.
<Subject 2> is the apartment environment in <Picture 2>: a small living room at night with plain light walls, a wooden desk, a lamp with a pleated shade giving warm light, a beige sofa and a tall window with rain on the glass.

summary:
[reference generation] At night in <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> stands beside the rainy window, turned toward the camera, and looks out at the city, lost in thought.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her face, facial proportions, eye shape, eyebrows, low side ponytail and long beige-grey cardigan are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the tall rainy window, light walls, beige sofa and pleated lamp are retained as the setting.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic, live-action short-drama shot at night, with warm lamp light inside and cool blue city light from the window, natural skin texture and realistic colors.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up in three-quarter front view, standing beside the tall window of <Subject 2>; the camera is inside the room at her eye level, and her face, turned toward the camera at an angle, is large in the frame and in sharp focus. The window is at the left of the frame, raindrops running down the glass with blurred city lights behind them, and cool blue light falls on one side of her face; warm light from the lamp with the pleated shade, out of focus at the right edge of the frame, lights the other side. Behind her, softly out of focus but recognisable, are the plain light wall and the beige sofa of <Subject 2>. She wears her long beige-grey cardigan over a light top, its soft knit texture visible where the lamp light catches it, her arms loosely folded, and her long dark hair is gathered in a low side ponytail over one shoulder. Faint reflections of the room and of her own silhouette show in the dark glass of the window. Her skin shows natural texture and fine pores, her eyelashes are sharp, and the city lights make small moist highlights in her eyes. Her eyes look out of the window toward the city lights far away, focused in the distance; she blinks once. After a moment her gaze drops to the raindrops on the glass close to her and follows one drop down; then her eyes return to the distance. She takes a slow breath, her shoulders settle, and her mouth stays relaxed without a smile. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical, pupils aimed at the same point, and her facial proportions stay unchanged; she never looks into the lens and never turns her back to the camera. Her lips stay closed; she does not speak. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her face. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain against the window, faint distant traffic, and a quiet room tone.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
